mapper.sql: t.id, t.club_name, t.category, t.attach_unit, t.found_date, t.leader_name, t.advisor_name, t.status, t.created_at, t.updated_at, t.deleted, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM club_member m WHERE m.club_id = t.id AND m.deleted = 0 AND m.quit_date IS NULL) AS member_count

sql.if: AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM club_member cm JOIN student_profile csp ON csp.user_id = cm.user_id AND csp.deleted = 0 WHERE cm.club_id = t.id AND cm.deleted = 0 AND cm.quit_date IS NULL AND csp.counselor_id = #{scopeCounselorId})
AND (t.club_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR t.attach_unit LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR t.leader_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO club (club_name, category, attach_unit, found_date, leader_name, advisor_name, status, created_at, updated_at, deleted) VALUES (#{clubName}, #{category}, #{attachUnit}, #{foundDate}, #{leaderName}, #{advisorName}, #{status}, NOW(), NOW(), 0)
mapper.update: UPDATE club SET deleted = 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM club t WHERE t.deleted = 0 AND t.status = #{status}
SELECT t.category AS category, COUNT(*) AS total FROM club t WHERE t.deleted = 0 GROUP BY t.category ORDER BY t.category
SELECT t.status AS status, COUNT(*) AS total FROM club t WHERE t.deleted = 0 GROUP BY t.status ORDER BY t.status
